what: citation_verified uses PPE's curated vocabulary: "yes (abstracts)" when every key citation of a row is verified at abstract level (all 67 rows), "partly (abstracts)" or "no" otherwise. Pack 0.1 wrote "all", which the shared core renders in the unverified style.

Cleared the 17 lint withholdings from the K-item build: reworded four path notes, four legend lines, the LZY mapping (three molecules) and T-GAP-01 so no internal terms reach the app; allowed_phrases for the two About framing lines (contested-framing) and for TODO(author) and "Open items (TODO)" (jargon). Contested-sense hypothesis lines cite by author and year instead of reference keys (PZ06, PZ07). Scenario w2: Calvo et al. 2019.

First pack: 67 curated paths in 16 branches; 152 references verified by title ratio with verbatim abstracts; 120 molecules (reviewed UniProt, AGI loci) with 116 bundled featured structures; 41 small molecules; 68 Plant Ontology terms; plant stage kinds (core_schema 0.2); audience, planner, safety, scenarios (w1–w11), upkeep.
